args.message: Likely Rack B vent blockage (posterior 1.0). Physics predicts limit breach in hidden Rack B if nothing done. Requesting power cap to contain.

data.text:
Hazard likely in hidden Rack B.

Found:
- All 5 sensors live, none flat/stuck, trusted.
- S1 +1.1C residual, S1 and S3 trending up ~0.1C/10min. M1 dropped ~4.5 to ~3.8 kW ~30 min ago.
- estimate_hidden_zones: Rack B 29.8C +/-2, margin 5.2C to 35C limit - but warns it underestimates blocked-vent faults.
- diagnose: posterior 1.0 vent_rackB blocked up to 95%, onset ~80 min ago. p_breach=1.0 within 90min if nothing done.

Tested:
- clear_vent rackB, backup cooling rackB, power_cap rackB 0.6. All still p_breach=1 but reduce peak margin from +1.9C to +1.2-1.4C. Power-cap fastest (3 min) and best.
- Critical notify sent. No request_action approved yet.

Human next:
- Treat Rack B as overheating now - inspect vent/airflow blockage immediately, check for hot smell/damage.
- Manually power-cap / shed Rack B load, enable backup cooling until vent cleared.
- Do not rely on S1/S2/S3 - Rack B is uninstrumented.
